```{r setup,include = F}

library(here)
library(knitr)

```

```{r substrate proportions,echo = F,out.width = "100%",fig.align = "center",fig.cap = "Substrate relative observation proportions per survey year with manual faceting by groups defined by similarity. Similarity can further be specified as close relative proportion at survey year 8 or logical similarity, such as all herbaceous substrates, etc. Facet wrap was not used because I found that the faceted plots were too squished. Manual faceting with the patchwork package seemed to improve readability. I would have liked to have found a way to combine the x-axes and y-axes labels but with the blank plot in the bottom right made this difficult."}

figure1path <- here("code","from_Matt_Vinh","Substrate_Proportions_1_25-11-29.pdf")
include_graphics(figure1path)

```

```{r seasons nmds,echo = F,out.width = "100%",fig.align = "center",fig.cap = "Seasons NMDS with the top 5 most abundant species per season included. Other than the addition of species, the figure is the same."}

figure2path <- here("code","from_Matt_Vinh","Season_NMDS_25-11-29.pdf")
include_graphics(figure2path)

```

```{r maximum abunudance nmds,echo = F,out.width = "100%",fig.align = "center",fig.cap = "Maximum species abundance per survey per survey year NMDS with the top 3 greatest yearly maximum species per survey year included. Additionally, this NMDS now has a veridis color scale and arrows portraying the continuous progression of survey years, connecting the sites by continuous survey year."}

figure3path <- here("code","from_Matt_Vinh","Maximum_Survey_per_Year_NMDS_25-11-29.pdf")
include_graphics(figure3path)

```
